mapper.select: SELECT ms_shopping_cart.shopping_cart_id, ms_shopping_cart.product_id, ms_shopping_cart.product_quantity, ms_shopping_cart.total_amount, ms_shopping_cart.product_name, ms_shopping_cart.specification, ms_shopping_cart.product_price, ms_shopping_cart.product_image FROM ms_shopping_cart WHERE ms_shopping_cart.user_id = #{userId} AND ms_shopping_cart.store_id = #{storeId}
